prompts.name: 13-space-rabbit
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: native 2.13 inch three-ink e-paper artwork. Create one finished wide 250:122 aspect ratio illustration of a small rabbit astronaut sitting on a crescent moon, one bold red planet and sparse black stars in a white deep space, charming quiet silhouette. Designed for final 250 by 122 pixels: large legible shapes, crisp contours at small size, deliberate negative space, sophisticated composition. ONLY solid black #000000, solid paper white #FFFFFF, solid red #BE0000. No grey, no colors other than these three. No gradients, no dithering, no stipple noise, no tiny texture, no text, no logos, no borders. Flat screenprint/woodcut illustration, clean pixel-friendly silhouettes. Keep all important forms inside the composition. Landscape image with aspect 2.049:1.
